info.name: Secure Office
info.summary: Granular Role-based DLP, Forensic Watermarking, Native Files Traceability, and Delegated Administration for ENS (RD 311/2022)
info.description:
Nextcloud Secure Office is an enterprise security extension designed for environments requiring high-assurance data protection, forensic traceability, granular role-based Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and governance delegation across both collaborative office documents in Nextcloud Office (Collabora Online / CODE) and native Nextcloud files (PDFs, images, archives, etc.).
Specifically architected to assist public administrations, educational institutions, critical infrastructures, and regulated entities in meeting the baseline established in Spain's National Cryptologic Center (CCN-CERT) guideline and National Security Framework: - [CCN-STIC-826: Implementación de Seguridad Nextcloud](https://www.ccn-cert.cni.es/es/800-guia-esquema-nacional-de-seguridad/4229-ccn-stic-826-implementacion-de-seguridad-nextcloud/file.html) - Esquema Nacional de Seguridad (ENS - Real Decreto 311/2022) - Medium / High baseline.
Modular Security Architecture & Key Capabilities: 1. Module 1 - Collaborative Office Protection (Collabora Online / CODE): - Dynamic Forensic Watermarking ([mp.info.6]): Injects real-time indelible background watermarks displaying user identity, client IP, access timestamp, and classification tags. - Granular Role-Based DLP ([mp.info.6]): Define permissions per role/group to allow or prohibit unencrypted document downloads/export (DisableExport), clipboard copying (DisableCopy), and printing (DisablePrint).
2. Module 2 - Native Files Protection & Traceability (Nextcloud Files): - Native File Traceability ([mp.info.2]): Automated, immutable audit trail logging all downloads and access to native files (PDF, images, ZIPs, binaries) in oc_secure_office_audit with direct CSV export. - Role-Based Native File DLP ([mp.info.6]): Restrict direct file downloads to authorized roles/groups (e.g., Direction, Teachers), preventing unauthorized exfiltration while allowing controlled viewing.
3. Institutional Governance & Delegated Administration ([org.1], [org.2], [mp.ac.3]): - Responsable de la Información (ENS RD 311/2022): Empowers designated managerial roles (such as School Directors, Department Heads, or Security Officers) to govern DLP policies and inspect audit records directly from the app interface without requiring global IT superadmin privileges. - Policy Change Traceability ([mp.info.2]): Every update to DLP rules or authorized groups is automatically recorded in the audit log (POLICY_CHANGE) with user identity, origin IP, and UTC timestamp. - User Transparency Dashboard: Transparent view for everyday users (teachers, staff, students) displaying which security classification and DLP policies apply to their active session.
4. Cross-Platform Compliance: - Storage Encryption Compatibility ([mp.info.3]): Full compatibility with Nextcloud Server-Side Encryption (SSE) with Master Key mode (AES-256-CTR). - Channel Protection Auditing ([mp.info.4]): Audits and enforces strict TLS/HTTPS transport across browser sessions and Collabora WOPI endpoints. - Continuous Compliance Engine & CLI: Features a diagnostic dashboard in Administration Settings and terminal auditor (occ secure_office:ens-audit).
---
### Production Deployment Considerations (ENS [mp.info.4] Compliance)
To achieve full compliance in production environments, particularly for communication channel protection (ENS Measure [mp.info.4] - Tránsito Seguro):
1. Mandatory HTTPS & TLS Hardening: Deploy Nextcloud and Collabora Online behind a hardened reverse proxy (Nginx, Traefik, Apache, or Caddy) equipped with trusted TLS/SSL certificates. Enforce TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3 with forward secrecy.
2. Nextcloud Protocol Enforcement (config/config.php): Ensure Nextcloud enforces HTTPS across all generated URLs and CLI operations: 'overwriteprotocol' => 'https', 'overwrite.cli.url' => 'https://nextcloud.yourdomain.com',
3. HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS): Configure your reverse proxy to send the HSTS header: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=15552000; includeSubDomains; preload
4. Secure Collabora WOPI Communication: Configure Nextcloud Office (richdocuments) to communicate with Collabora exclusively over HTTPS: php occ config:app:set richdocuments wopi_url --value="https://collabora.yourdomain.com" This guarantees that all in-flight documents and WOPI authentication tokens travel exclusively across encrypted channels.
5. At-Rest Encryption Activation (ENS [mp.info.3]): php occ app:enable encryption php occ encryption:enable-master-key php occ encryption:enable php occ encryption:encrypt-all
6. Continuous Compliance Verification: Verify your global compliance status at any time with the built-in terminal auditor: php occ secure_office:ens-audit
